verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own background automation: Auto-Sync commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected, and Background Sync keeps this running while you use other apps, though it pauses after long periods without changes. That automation is a single fixed sync behavior rather than user-configurable autonomous workflows. Its Shortcuts and x-callback-url hooks expose actions, but any triggers or schedules would come from the host platform. The Repository Agent is conversational, not background. Missing for 10: user-definable autonomous automations beyond sync, a first-party recurring schedule or trigger system, background agent execution, and independent corroboration of reliable background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: _Auto-Sync_ does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.
Turn on _Background Sync_ to keep syncing while you use other apps, which uses your location and extra battery and pauses after long periods without changes.
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
